dwelling_habits.dwelling: On soft corals and sea fans it slowly eats.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Mantle flaps cover the shell with leopard-like spots.
dwelling_habits.mating: Lays egg capsules on the same fans it grazes.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Tiny living jewelry — look, don’t pocket.

fun_facts: The spots are soft mantle tissue, not paint on the shell.
When threatened, the mantle retracts and the shell looks plain cream.
